# badgelife (device class)

> Conference badges and SAOs — serial console, flashing, and the USB bridges they use

A device class rather than a single device: conference badges, SAOs and the development boards they are built from, nearly all of which present as a USB serial port either natively or through a CP210x or CH34x bridge.

## Devices in this class

- [c5-wardriver](c5-wardriver.md)
- [clip-boy](clip-boy.md)
- [meshtastic](meshtastic.md)
- [minino](minino.md)

## Shared setup

Install the class packages, add yourself to dialout and plugdev, then log out and back in — group membership does not apply to an existing session. Plug the badge in; it appears as `/dev/ttyACM0` (or `/dev/serial/by-id/...` where the board supplies a serial). `tio /dev/ttyACM0` opens a console; 115200 8N1 is the usual default. This class emits no `/dev/badge-*` symlink — see the NO CLASS-LEVEL SYMLINK note below for why.

## Shared tooling

[`esptool`](../packages/esptool.md), [`minicom`](../packages/minicom.md), [`screen`](../packages/screen.md), [`tio`](../packages/tio.md)
